glossary.role: Daba's adopted younger sister and fiancee. Kidnapped and brainwashed by Poseidal via bio-relation; reappears as commander of Poseidal's Imperial Guard. Pilots a copper-yellow Calvary Temple.
glossary.personality: Under mind control she is cold and obedient, acting on Poseidal's orders; underneath she is fragile, and her mind breaks down by the end of the series.

glossary.role: The in-universe 1970s-style super robot anime (full title ゲキ・ガンガー3) loved by Gai Daigoji and Akito; also the name of its robot.
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Upgraded Jovian Tetsujin (Tsukumo; later Takasugi)
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Giwaza Lowau's rebel fleet (mostly Sarge Opus planet cruisers of the Thirteen) that turns against Poseidal.
Upgraded Jovian Majin (Tsukiomi)
The Pentagona System / Pentagona World: the five-planet star system where L-Gaim is set (Koam, Mizum, Gastogal, Trydetol, ...).

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: Lieutenant Commander in the Jovian Superior Jovian Male Forces; Tetsujin/Daitetsujin pilot; seeks peace with Earth
glossary.personality: Honest, upright and idealistic, naive around women; hot-blooded Gekiganger fan

glossary.role: Earth Federation captain (Captain, 大佐) of the assault carrier Albion; leads the pursuit of the stolen GP02.
glossary.personality: Grizzled veteran with a commanding presence and keen tactical mind; relies on his own judgement and sense of right and wrong.

glossary.role: Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).
glossary.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship
Short form of Nergal Heavy Industries (ネルガル側, ネルガルの戦艦ナデシコ).
Earth's name for the unknown Jovian enemy (actually the Jovian Federation, 木連).

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: cook and Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico, a Class-A Boson Jumper. PoD: the "Prince of Darkness", Black Sarena pilot hunting the Martian Successors
glossary.personality: TV: kind, reluctant and insecure Gekiganger fan who wants to be a cook. PoD: cold, grim and vengeful after experiments destroyed his senses

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Nergal scientist aboard the Nadesico (Mars survivor); explains the technology
glossary.personality: Brilliant, self-absorbed lecturer who loves giving "explanations"; secretly the grown-up Ai

glossary.role: Original Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (real name Jiro Yamada); killed early in the TV series
glossary.personality: Loud, hot-blooded, obsessed with Gekiganger III; insists Gai is his soul's name

glossary.role: Generic new soldier.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Officer of the Jovian Superior Jovian Male Forces (Yuujin Butai), Majin/Daimajin pilot; in PoD a Nergal operative who trained Akito
glossary.personality: Proud, serious, intensely idealistic; haunted by having shot his friend Tsukumo

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Jupiter-based anti-Earth state, main enemy faction of the TV series (romaji Mokuren)

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>結論から<im(1)>言っちゃいます。
#c[BE5050]木星蜥蜴#cは……過去に地球から
追放された人たちだったんです！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>I'll get straight to <im(1)>the point:
The #c[BE5050]Jovian Lizards#c are... people who
were banished from Earth in the past!
rows.notes: Yurika: revealing the truth behind the Jovian Lizards

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>１００年前、月に移民した彼らの先祖は、
地球に対して独立運動を始めました。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>A century ago, their ancestors who had
migrated to the Moon began a movement
for independence from Earth.
rows.notes: Yurika: lunar independence movement

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>でも、それを快く思わない地球の人たちは、
月の人たちが内部分裂するように仕向け、
最後まで地球との共存を拒否した人たちを
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(2)>But Earth was displeased by this, and
schemed to divide the people of the Moon.
Those who refused to coexist with Earth...
rows.notes: Yurika: Earth inciting division among lunar colonists

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>追放しちゃったんです。
追放された人たちは、月から、
さらに火星へと逃げていきました。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>...were banished into exile!
Those exiled people fled from the Moon,
escaping all the way to Mars.
rows.notes: Yurika: flight to Mars

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>その後、地球では彼らの存在を
全ての記録から抹殺しました。
それというのも、当時の地球政府が……
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(4)>After that, Earth erased their existence
from all records. That was because
the Earth government at the time...
rows.notes: Yurika: historical erasure

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>火星に……追放された人たちに……
核を撃ち込んだからです。
裏工作の証拠を消すために…
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>...launched nuclear weapons at Mars...
at the exiled people... all to erase
the evidence of their cover-up...
rows.notes: Yurika: nuclear bombardment of Mars to cover up the conspiracy

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(5)>そこで生き残った人たちは、
さらに木星へと逃げていくしか
なかったんです。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(5)>The people who survived there had no
choice but to flee even farther,
all the way to Jupiter.
rows.notes: Yurika: survivors fled to Jupiter

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>何とか木星へ逃げのびた人たちは、
火星で発見された遺跡と同じ古代遺跡を
発見して、自分たちの国を作ったんです。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>Those who managed to escape to Jupiter
found ancient ruins like those on Mars,
and established their own nation.
rows.notes: Yurika: founding of Mokuren using ancient ruins

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(6)>地球から持っていったアニメ、
「#c[E2E258]ゲキ・ガンガー３#c」だけを心の支えに。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(6)>With only an anime brought from Earth,
"#c[E2E258]Gekiganger 3#c", to keep their
spirits alive.
rows.notes: Yurika: Gekiganger 3 as the Jovians' emotional foundation

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>それ以来……#c[E2E258]木星連合#cの人たちは、
ずっと地球への復讐のチャンスを
狙ってきたそうです。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>Ever since... the people of the
#c[E2E258]Jovian Federation#c have waited for
a chance to take revenge on Earth.
rows.notes: Yurika: Jovian desire for revenge

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(8)>そして、ついにその機会が訪れたんです。
#c[BE5050]ギガノス#cや、#c[BE5050]デラーズ#cを利用することで。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(8)>And that opportunity finally came.
By making use of #c[BE5050]Giganos#c
and #c[BE5050]Delaz#c.
rows.notes: Yurika: Mokuren utilizing Giganos and Delaz Fleet

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>でもですね、こちらで一旦捕虜にした
白鳥九十九さんと、クルーが仲良く
なったことから#c[BE5050]木連#c側の話が聞けたんです。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>But you see, our crew bonded with
Tsukumo Shiratori while held prisoner,
learning the #c[BE5050]Jovian Federation#c's side.
rows.notes: Yurika: friendship with Tsukumo Shiratori

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(9)>それで、#c[BE5050]木連#cのほうにも
戦争をやめたいって思っている人が
いることがわかったんですよ。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(9)>Through that, we learned that on the
#c[BE5050]Jovian#c side, too, there are people
who want to put an end to the war.
rows.notes: Yurika: peace faction within Mokuren

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>ですから、私たち、木星に行って
和平交渉をしてこようかと思うんです！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>So, we are going to travel to Jupiter
and attempt peace negotiations ourselves!
rows.notes: Yurika: Nadesico mission to Jupiter

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>お父様に言えば反対されるだろうし、
ネルガルの上層部にも、
反対する人が多いとは思います。
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>I am sure my father would oppose this,
and many in Nergal's upper management
would object as well.
rows.notes: Yurika: expected opposition from her father and Nergal

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>それは、#c[BE5050]木連#cのほうも同じらしいんですが……
でも、もう、私たち、誰かが死んだり、
傷ついたりするのは嫌なんです！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>It seems to be the same with the
#c[BE5050]Jovians#c... But we just do not want
anyone else to die or get hurt anymore!
rows.notes: Yurika: plea against casualties

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(11)>だから、私たち、<im(12)>木星に行きます！
とにかく、戦いを終わらせたいんです！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)><im(11)>So we are going <im(12)>to Jupiter!
Above all, we want to end this fighting!
rows.notes: Yurika: determination to end the war

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>私たちらしいやり方で、
宇宙のみんなが
幸せになれるようにしたいんです！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>In our own way, we want to make sure
everyone in space can find happiness!
rows.notes: Yurika: doing things in their own Nadesico way

rows.jp:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>ですから……シナプス艦長たちとは、
ここでお別れです！
……お父様によろしく！
rows.en:
<op(32,1)><sp(2)>And so... Captain Sinapus, this is where
we say goodbye! Please give my father
my best regards!
rows.notes: Yurika: saying farewell to Sinapus

rows.jp:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>艦長。
いまの通信を聞いたクルー全員の
答えは一つです。
rows.en:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>Captain. Having heard that transmission,
the crew has only one answer.
rows.notes: Noin: speaking for the Albion crew to Sinapus

rows.jp:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>全員、#c[5E8FD8]ナデシコ#cに協力したいと。
無駄な戦争を終わらせることができるなら、
どんなことでもすると。
rows.en:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>All of them wish to assist the #c[5E8FD8]Nadesico#c.
If this senseless war can be ended, they
are willing to do whatever it takes.
rows.notes: Noin: crew solidarity with Nadesico

rows.jp:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>上層部は、過去の事件を世間に隠蔽し、
人々を騙して戦わせていたのです。
艦長、ご命令を。
rows.en:
<op(36,1)><sp(2)>High Command concealed the past from the
public, deceiving people into fighting.
Captain, your orders.
rows.notes: Noin: requesting orders from Sinapus

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>こんなことを隠していたとは呆れる…
侵略ではなく、復讐だったということか…
地球の人間自身が招いたものだったのだ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>To think they hid such a thing... It was
not an invasion, but revenge... Brought
about by the people of Earth themselves.
rows.notes: Sinapus: disgusted by Earth government's deception

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>これ以上の犠牲が避けられるなら、
軍規違反と言えど全力を尽くすべきだろう。
……あの時のようにな。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>If further sacrifice can be prevented,
we must do our utmost, even in defiance
of military code. ...Just like back then.
rows.notes: Sinapus: echoing his defiance in Gundam 0083

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)>全員、配置に着け！
今すぐ#c[5E8FD8]ナデシコ#cを追う！
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)>All hands, man your battle stations!
Pursue the #c[5E8FD8]Nadesico#c immediately!
rows.notes: Sinapus: ordering the Albion to follow the Nadesico

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>「ナデシコとアルビオン」

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　プリベンター　レディ・アン
rows.en:
<sp(0)>"The Nadesico and Albion"

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　Preventer Lady Une
rows.notes: Preventer report header. fix: double space and leading spaces -> replaced with fullwidth Japanese spaces

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>ネルガル月面ドックに停泊中の
#c[5E8FD8]戦艦ナデシコ#cは、<im(1)>地球への帰還命令を
無視し、木星圏へと進路を取った。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Anchored at Nergal's lunar dock,
the #c[5E8FD8]battleship Nadesico#c <im(1)>defied orders
to return to Earth, heading for Jupiter.
rows.notes: Lady Une: Nadesico departs lunar dock for Jupiter

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>彼らは#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#c本部に、#c[BE5050]木星蜥蜴#cとの
<im(3)>和平交渉を行う旨をすでに伝えており、
上層部の反対を押し切り、出発した形だ。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>They notified #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c HQ of their intent to
conduct peace talks with #c[BE5050]Jovian Lizards#c,
<im(3)>departing over High Command's objections.
rows.notes: Lady Une: Nadesico's unauthorized peace mission

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#c上層部は、<im(2)>これを独断行動に
当たるとして、同艦への厳重な対処を
検討中である。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>#c[5E8FD8]UCE#c High Command deems <im(2)>this unauthorized
action, and is considering severe
measures against the vessel.
rows.notes: Lady Une: UCE considering disciplinary measures

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>「ギワザ艦隊の目的」

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　プリベンター　レディ・アン
rows.en:
<sp(0)>"Objectives of the Giwaza Fleet"

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　Preventer Lady Une
rows.notes: Preventer report header. fix: double space and leading spaces -> replaced with fullwidth Japanese spaces

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>#c[BE5050]ポセイダル#cの先遣隊である#c[BE5050]ギワザ艦隊#cの
最近の動向について報告する。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>This report covers recent movements of
#c[BE5050]Poseidal#c's vanguard, the #c[BE5050]Giwaza Fleet#c.
rows.notes: Lady Une: reporting on Giwaza Fleet movements

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>彼らのこれまでの動きは、オルファン<im(1)>を
新兵器の一種と捉え、その強制占拠を優先
させた作戦行動であると判断されてきた。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Their actions until now were <im(1)>assessed as
prioritizing the seizure of Orphan, which
they regarded as a new type of weapon.
rows.notes: Lady Une: Giwaza's priority was capturing Orphan

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>しかしここにきて同艦隊は、#c[BE5050]バスターアーク#c
を<im(2)>始めとして、いくつかの強力な兵器の情報
も集めていることが明らかとなった。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>However, starting with the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c, <im(2)>the
fleet is evidently gathering intelligence
on several other powerful weapons.
rows.notes: Lady Une: Giwaza gathering intel on Buster Ark and other tech

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>ここから推測するに、彼らはその占有目標を
ペンタゴナに存在しないテクノロジー全般に
まで、広げてきたのではないか。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>From this, we infer they have broadened
their targets to encompass any technology
not found within Pentagona.
rows.notes: Lady Une: Giwaza's ambitions expanding to foreign technology

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>また#c[BE5050]ギワザ艦隊#cには、#c[E2E258]クワサン・オリビー#c
という人物の指揮する#c[BE5050]ポセイダル#c親衛隊が
監視役として同行していることも判明した。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Moreover, the #c[BE5050]Giwaza Fleet#c is accompanied

report.translator_summary: Translated Operation 18 Phase 2 dev scratch labels, debriefing where Yurika reveals the origin of the Jovian Lizards (human survivors of Earth's nuclear strike on Mars who founded Mokuren with Gekiganger 3 as their spiritual guide) and announces their voyage to Jupiter for peace talks, leading Sinapus to follow them in defiance of orders, followed by Lady Une's Preventer reports on the Nadesico's unauthorized mission and the Giwaza Fleet's technological ambitions.
uncertainties: m6182#66-85: Developer scratch placeholder labels translated succinctly within parentheses.

brief63185#0-18: Rendered Yurika's revelation of the dark history behind the Jovians with her characteristic earnest and lively cadence, juxtaposing the tragedy of the nuclear bombing of Mars and their reliance on Gekiganger 3 with her resolute drive to end the war.
brief63185#23: Sinapus's line 'あの時のようにな' is a direct nod to Operation Stardust in Gundam 0083, where he took the Albion rogue for the greater good.
brief63265#1-6: Preserved precise color tagging sequence and formal intelligence tone in Lady Une's analysis of Giwaza's interest in Buster Ark and Quwasan Olibee's oversight role.
